newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares climb in late rally, falls looming.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares climb in late rally, falls looming.

text.p: Danish share prices closed higher on Thursday, recovering in late trading after following the rest of Europe down most of the day, but dealers predicted declines up to the weekend.
"We fell most of the day but towards the end of trading interest suddenly revived. Wall Street opened negatively and if that trend continues falls are inevitable," one dealer said.

The KFX top-20 index finished 0.28 point to 127.44 in overall bourse turnover of 707 million crowns. The KFX December future fell 0.40 point to 127.65 with 145 contracts each worth 100,000 crowns traded.

Tele Danmark was once again the day's most traded paper, with 165,000 shares changing hands, to close five crowns down at 287 after a newspaper article calling for refunds for the telecoms group's telephone subscribers.
SAS Danmark rose 0.40 crown to 72.50 on rumours of pending cost cuts, while Novo Nordisk shot 11 crowns ahead to finish at 995 on news of a big new order.
NKT closed three crowns up at 320 on a revised strategic plan for the year 2000 although some analysts said it did not contain anything new.
